title: ISP Algorithm Engineer, up to Sr. - Color processing
description: Company: Qualcomm Korea YH Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering General Summary: The successful candidate will be responsible for end-to-end development of color processing algorithms within the Snapdragon ISP pipeline. This includes algorithm design, tuning, validation, and close collaboration with system, sensor, hardware, and IQ teams to deliver production-ready automotive imaging solutions. This role requires deep expertise in image processing with a strong focus on color science , hands-on ISP algorithm development experience, and the ability to balance image quality, performance, and hardware efficiency. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and optimize color processing algorithms for Gen6 ISP platforms Develop and maintain core ISP color modules, including but not limited to: Auto White Balance (AWB) Color Correction Matrix (CCM) Color Space Conversion (CSC) Gamma & Tone Curve Processing 3D Color Look-Up Table (3D LUT) Color Gamut Mapping Skin Tone Preservation / Enhancement Perform color tuning and evaluation using objective metrics and subjective image quality assessment Prototype, evaluate, and validate algorithms on embedded ISP hardware Collaborate with cross-functional teams (camera system, sensor, optics, hardware, and validation teams) to integrate and release ISP color solutions Balance color accuracy, stability, latency, and power efficiency Minimum Qualifications 3+ years of industry experience in image processing or ISP algorithm development Strong background in color processing and image signal processing fundamentals Hands-on development experience with C/C++ (Python experience for prototyping or analysis is a plus) Solid understanding of color science concepts (color spaces, color transforms, tone curves, white balance) Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications Experience with ISP color pipelines and real-world tuning workflows Experience in mobile camera systems, imaging applications Knowledge of camera sensors, optics, and sensor characterization affecting color behavior Experience with HDR color processing and cross-illumination color consistency Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware-accelerated ISP architectures Educational Requirements Required: Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience Preferred: Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field Keywords ISP, Color Processing, Color Science, AWB, CCM, 3D LUT, CSC, Gamma, HDR Color, Camera Systems Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
